summary:
Bram is a terrifying Alpha. Until he opens his mouth.

He’s six-foot-four, built like a tank, and commands the respect of his entire pack. But thanks to a cruel twist of genetics, his howl sounds less like a wolf and more like a stepped-on squeaky toy. It’s humiliating. It’s undignified. It’s ruining his street cred.

Enter Sebastian.

Sebastian is a classical vocal coach with a velvet vest, a riding crop, and zero tolerance for failure. He doesn't care that Bram can rip a door off its hinges; he only cares about diaphragm control and posture.

Bram hires him for secret lessons, expecting boring scales. What he gets is a strict taskmaster who isn’t afraid to bring a powerful Alpha to his knees. Bram discovers that submitting to Sebastian’s "discipline" is the biggest rush of his life.

The lessons are about to move from the music room to the bedroom, and Sebastian demands perfect performance in both.

A reformed convict who doesn’t want to go back to the streets. An illicit Miami movie studio in need of a new star. What could go wrong?

After fifteen years in prison, Trev needs a fresh start. Refusing to go back to his old ways on the streets, he makes up his mind to leverage his muscles and looks into a new career—Miami Beach adult movie star. After all, how hard could it possibly be?

Amatory Films CEO Janelle Babin knows Trev is the whole package, and she can’t get him on film fast enough. He’s got the perfect hook—a bad boy former convict who hasn’t had sex in fifteen years. But what she doesn’t count on is Trev’s co-star Kandi crossing the one line in the sand in their business—falling in love.

Kandi and Trev set the sheets—and their hearts—on fire from the first minute they see each other. But with more women than Trev can handle throwing themselves at him and Kandi’s ex-boyfriend refusing to let her go, can they overcome everything that the world wants to throw at them?

Can two people like Kandi and Trev really find love with each other? And what happens when the dust settles and the cameras switch off?

Readers of seductive urban romance, dark urban interracial romance, and urban romance novels with an amazing ending won’t be able to get enough of this new novel from Victor L. Martin. Filled with love, lust, drama and intrigue, this African-American urban fiction novel is one of the best new entries in the street literature genre.

1-Click to start reading today!

They rule this campus by breaking people. Then each one meets the man he can’t break.

Four Ridgemount U romances. Four men with all the power. Four men who break their one rule: never be seen.

  • COLD CROWN: a legacy lacrosse captain, the first-year scholarship student he tries to erase, and a captaincy he loses if anyone sees them after dark.
  • BROKEN MASK: a closeted pre-med frat treasurer, the art major he humiliated two years ago, and a med-school future one photo could end.
  • LOCK DOWN: a by-the-book senior RA, the rule-breaking transfer in Room 312, and a scholarship riding on write-ups that were never about the rules.
  • STILL HANDS: a brutal lacrosse captain, the first-year walk-on he refuses to haze, and a teammate’s ledger that could cost him the team.

Four complete standalone novellas, four happy endings, one box set.

If you love bully romance, closeted men with everything to lose and enemies to lovers with real stakes, start here.

Dark, explicit, open-door MM college romance for readers 18+. All characters are adults. Content notes: bullying, hazing, a homophobic slur, outing threats, power imbalance.

Four men with power over a player’s career. Four hands that stay a second too long.

A coach’s thumb on a rookie’s hip. A therapist’s hands on a torn shoulder.

A legend’s palm on a player’s neck. An owner’s fingers at a star’s collar.

  • COACHED: A head coach with twenty years behind the bench and the twenty-three-year-old rookie he keeps for one-on-ones at six a.m.
  • STRETCHED: A rehab specialist with the best hands in the program and the injured winger who can’t stop feeling them.
  • BENCHED: A retired enforcer turned skills coach and the invisible third-liner he is the first to truly see.
  • TRADED: The owner who can trade him before the deadline, and the star center he says he wants to keep.

Four forbidden age gaps. A roster spot, a licence, a jersey, a no-trade clause. Each one is a single door, camera or signature from gone.

Sports Daddy Books 1–4: four complete standalone novellas, four happy endings, one box set.

If you love a forbidden age gap, powerful older men who break their own rules and hockey players discovering their first time with a man, start here.

Explicit, open-door MM age-gap romance between consenting adults, 18+. Content notes: power imbalances at work, sports injuries, secret relationships, fear of being outed.

Relationships are complex. Love, ever-changing. And when it comes to rules of the heart, they were made to be broken....

That's what Robert Antonio Bianchi was telling himself, anyway. Otherwise, he really had no excuse for what - or who - he'd done. No excuse, except for his lonely heart, a pitcher of margaritas, four bitter bitches, and the apparent need to confess all his weaknesses to the two men he knew would bring him nothing but trouble.

But trouble was nothing new. Just ask his crazy sisters or any of his friends, and they'd be the first to tell you: If there was a bad decision to be made, Robbie always had a knack for making it. And thus, begins the story of the priest, the princess, and the prick.

At Silverton University, the Alpha Gods don't just rule the school, they dominate it.

Before I'd even enrolled, I was warned about them: The four Alpha Gods that ruled the school. They could get away with anything- even murder.

All I had to do was avoid them and I'd be able to get my brother the life-saving treatments my enrollment at this school provided.

Simple, keep my head down and survive a few years.

My plan worked for all of one day, until Julian, the leader of the Alpha Gods, targeted my best friend. I knew the consequences of stopping his twisted game, but I'd always stood up for Rue, and old habits die hard. I grabbed the dogfood before Rue could be forced to eat it, and shoved it into Julian's mouth.

Now, I'm their target, and if I'm going to stay in this school, I'm going to have to figure out a way to endure the leader's cruel whims—even if it means dressing as a dog for his amusement.

There's no way I'll let them break me.

The Alpha Gods might think I'm their cute pet they can toy with now, but they'll be in for a rude awakening when I bite back.

A slow-burn why choose paranormal romance.
Warning, cliff-hanger ahead

On a plane bound for Tokyo, omega Brendan Prince and his alphas Viggo and Dane are thrilled to be reunited with Red, the fourth in their four-way romance. It’s been two months since the squad has been together, and they anticipate bringing him back home to Elworth after a long working holiday. But when they arrive in Japan, it becomes quickly apparent that something has changed with Red. After surviving so many trials, this new development could be what shatters the foursome’s incredible polyamorous bond.

The Keystone Alphas: Reunited is a story of best friends, family, and a powerful kind of love that can only be shared between three alphas and one omega. This spicy short story features plenty of heat and a happy ending. This book is part 3 in a serial and it's recommended you read book 1 (The Keystone Alphas) first.

Bryan Turner is a ruined omega.
Bought by a cruel alpha and desperate to give him an heir before he’s cast aside and his family loses everything.
Then Bryan learns the truth.
He can’t get pregnant.
With nowhere left to turn, he runs into the forbidden forest searching for a wolf cult rumored to wield dark fertility magic.
And finds Munok, Nugai, and Gan, the alpha shifter shamans from his twisted dreams.
They wake his heat. Sever his mate bond. Claim he was never broken—only waiting for them to claim him.
But now Bryan belongs to them. And these monsters don’t share what’s theirs.

Tropes:
  • Mistreated Omega
  • Fated Mates
  • Primal Magic
  • Monster/Ritual Vibes
  • Scent/Pheromones/Wolf Heat
  • Mate Marking

A dark omegaverse harem romance with wolf shifters, primal magic, mpreg, knotting, a mistreated omega, morally gray alphas, and a possessive why-choose romance. Intended for mature readers. The War-Torn Omegas series can be enjoyed in any order.

Omega Brendan Prince is alone and drowning. The brutal academics at Keystone Academy are crushing him, and one more failed exam might end his dreams forever. When he stumbles into the mysterious "Death March Study Squad," he expects a study group, not three gorgeous alpha seniors who take one look at a desperate freshman and decide he's theirs.

Viggo, the dark and mysterious leader who commands every room he enters. Dane, the free-spirited charmer who reads people like books and cooks like a dream. Red, the quiet football star whose massive frame hides the gentlest heart.

These best friends have shared everything their entire life—and Brendan quickly realizes they don't just want to tutor him. They want to keep him.

And he's falling for all three.

He’s my ex-lover’s son. That should have been enough to convince me to stay away. But when Levi plays his guitar, I can’t help but fall in love all over again.

They say it’s better to have loved and lost than never to have loved at all. I can tell you that’s not true. At the end of college, I lost the only man I’ve ever loved. Twenty-three years later, I’m a billionaire CEO of my own software company. I’m miserable, still heartbroken, and I push everyone away eventually.

The moment I decide it’s time to give up on dating forever, Levi appears, and my heart nearly stops beating. He’s the spitting image of my ex-lover. I try to leave, but the way he sings and plays that guitar… I’m under his spell before I even know what happened. However, I never expected him to single me out in the crowd and buy me a drink.

Love is easy with Levi. In an instant, I’m transported back to my college days. We spend long, hot nights in each other’s arms. I can’t get enough of him. He even calls me Daddy just to mess with me, but I wouldn’t mind making him my Boy.

Imagine my surprise when I finally agreed to meet his parents and standing there in the doorway was my ex-lover from all those years ago with his wife, the woman he left me for. He hasn’t forgotten me, and he’s the only thing standing between me and my happily ever after.

But I won’t give up on Levi, even if it means fighting my ex-lover to get him.

TROPES: billionaire, Daddy (NO age play), instalove, found family, forbidden love, and hurt/comfort.

Previously published under author Blake R. Wolfe. This title was moved to create less genre confusion, but the content remains the same.

A mysterious stranger. A sauna full of secrets. A single night that turns into something more…

Ty’s life is all routine—soulless cubicles by day, anonymous hookups at the bathhouse by night. No names. No strings. Just release. Until he walks into the steam-drenched sauna and meets him.

Kieran is massive, muscular, and more beast than man—literally. A werewolf with amber eyes, a dangerous growl, and a talent that makes Ty’s legs tremble. Their chemistry is instant. Explosive. And when Kieran takes him in the heat of the sauna, Ty expects it to end like every other hookup: fast, filthy, and forgettable.

But Kieran breaks the rules. He stays. He shares his name. And when they take a dip in the pool after, it’s not just lust in Kieran’s voice—it’s something deeper. Protective. Possessive. Maybe even… tender?

What starts as a primal encounter spirals into heated glances, unexpected tenderness, and a promise of more.

Raw, addictive, and emotionally charged, The Werewolf’s Sauna is a gay paranormal shifter romance about letting go of control, giving in to instinct, and discovering that sometimes the wildest love stories are the ones that feel like fate.

Fifteen years ago, I threw a few punches and left Hell Creek, Montana, for good, tired of being abandoned by my own family.

I only came back to bury the man who raised me.

Then the lawyer reads the will.

Dad left the ranch to both me and my stepbrother. Equal shares. One catch: we have to live in the same house and run the place together for a full year.

Or we lose all of it.

Cole Nelson has ice-blue eyes, a black cowboy hat, and fifteen years’ worth of hating me.

He thinks I abandoned them. But I think he’s stubborn, self-righteous, and impossible.

We’re probably both right.

Twelve months of early mornings, broken fences, and slammed doors with the one man in Montana who’d love to see me gone.

I want nothing more than to leave, but if I do, he loses the ranch too.

But the biggest problem is how badly I want to kiss him…

Tropes You Can Expect:

  • Enemies to Lovers
  • Stepbrothers
  • Forced Proximity
  • Inheritance With Strings Attached
  • Grumpy Rancher x City Boy
  • Snowed In: Only One Tent
  • The Morning Cuddle That Becomes A Habit
  • High Heat

Hell Creek Boys is an angsty, spicy contemporary MM cowboy romance written in first person with alternating POVs. This is book one in the Endless Sky series.

My new bodyguard is big, brawny, and oh-so straight. Who knew dodging paparazzi would become a full-contact sport between my heart and those strong, protective arms?

Can I survive playing a risky duet with a man who’s supposed to protect my body, not steal my heart?

I have a tiny panic attack after a big charity gig. In the middle of this meltdown, I crash into Jared, the big, broad-shouldered bodyguard. He’s calm, he’s caring, and he’s got this insanely perfect jawline that could carve marble.

Does it awaken feelings I’ve been trying to smash down harder than a whack-a-mole? Let’s just say my interior monologue starts playing a sexy saxophone solo the second our eyes meet.

Cue my bandmate Dylan prancing around with victory confetti, calling me out for my crush. But I’m too busy freaking out because some leaked photo of me at a gay club goes viral faster than a cat meme. It threatens to turn my shiny rockstar image into a tabloid sideshow.

And guess who gets hired to guard my body, in all the ways I wish he would? Jared. Now I’m stuck playing it cool while my new protector—looking like a Greek god who moonlights as a teddy bear—follows me everywhere.

While I’m busy pretending I don’t want to slurp chocolate syrup off him, the world is busy being awful. Fans turning on me, paparazzi swarming like vultures, and anxiety wrapping around my throat like a boa constrictor. Jared steps in, putting himself between me and the chaos, deflecting not just the literal flashbulbs but also the emotional grenades.

Before I know it, I’m leaning into his broad shoulders, feeling safe and warm.

So here I am, at a crossroads. Falling for the one person I’m supposed to keep at arm’s length. Do I keep living a rock ’n’ roll lie or risk it all for the man who just might be my backstage pass to real happiness. Will I finally grab love by the collar of its world-tour jacket and plant a big, sloppy kiss on it in front of everyone?

Leather clad heroes, steamy superpowered encounters, and a city where found family is stronger than any villain.

Vanguard City is known for two things: burly men and superheroes. For those who love both, it's a city filled with steamy possibilities.

But the real story is about the flawed men behind the capes.

Follow an unlikely group of bears navigating life in a city full of alter egos. A barista who saves a superhero with nothing but nerve. A designer who gives a reluctant hero a reason to suit up. A paramedic who hates heroes until he becomes one. A bartender who discovers he was always worth keeping. A daddy bear who finally chooses his heart over duty.

In Vanguard City, anyone can be a hero. It only takes heart.

The Heroes of Vanguard Boxed Set is over 1000 pages of burly M/M adventures with HEAs and no cliffhangers. Expect leather clad heroes, powers in the bedroom, found family, and ordinary men who turn out to be exactly what this city needed.

Heroes of Vanguard Boxed Set Includes

  • Irresistible Power (Prequel)
  • Infamous Heart
  • Infernal Justice
  • Iridescent Lust
  • Invincible Nemesis

The Men of Vanguard Universe:

  • Heroes of Vanguard Boxed Set
  • Villains of Vanguard Boxed Set
  • Grunts of Vanguard Boxed Set

Jake has spent years secretly in love with his best friend, Max. One drunken kiss back in college was the closest he ever got before Max buried the moment and moved on—without him. When Max announces his engagement to Monica, Jake is heartbroken but determined to be the best man at his wedding, even if it means watching the man he loves marry someone else.

A long weekend cruise for Max’s destination wedding was supposed to be a distraction, but one night at the ship’s bar changes everything. Enter Cooper—mature, confident, and devastatingly sexy. Their chemistry is undeniable, their night together hot and unforgettable… but when Jake wakes up, Cooper is gone.

The real shock comes when Jake is formally introduced to his mystery lover the next day—as Max’s estranged older brother.

Now, trapped on the cruise with a mountain of unresolved feelings, Jake finds himself drawn to Cooper in ways he never expected. Cooper is nothing like Max, and yet he challenges Jake in all the best ways. But as their undeniable connection deepens, Jake is forced to confront the past he’s never let go of—and the future he never saw coming.

With old feelings rising, new love forming, and a wedding that may or may not happen, Jake must decide where his heart truly belongs before the ship docks… and everything falls apart.

A steamy, heartfelt MM romance about love, longing, and taking the risk that could change everything.

Three years ago, while studying abroad I met a man who would change my life forever. In just one single night together, Ashby had satisfied me in ways I’d never experienced before, not with a single one of my ex-girlfriends. I wasn’t gay, though. I could never look at another man the way I looked at Ashby—and believe me, I tried.

Now, going into my junior year at Dogson University I’m fresh out of another failed relationship, and that encounter with Ashby still burns in my mind like it happened yesterday. I believed I would never meet my unicorn again—until the first day of class.

It’s him, Ashby Wallace. Correction: Professor Ashby Wallace. At first, it’s not clear if he even recognizes my face, but when he tells me to meet him in his office, I know I’m really in the doghouse. Ashby knows how to push all of the right buttons. His charm and stunning good looks could disarm anyone—hell, they managed to enrapture this straight bro. But will we be able to keep our taboo reunion a secret?


Teach a Bro Straight is a standalone novelette in the Doghouse Bros series set at Dogson University, the college where even the straightest dude can find himself craving a fellow bro. Fans of gay-for-you, teacher/student romance will eat this one up. WARNING! This book has high levels of heat that will definitely blow your undies off.

“Out of the frying pan, into the fire.” Chris Seitz just can’t catch a break. Driving west to escape the flooding that rocked his Georgia hometown, he finds himself stranded during a record monsoon in a rural Arizona town. With just a bag of clothes and the kitten he rescued from the flood, Chris has never felt more alone. Now the kitten has gotten lost, and Chris is nearing the end of his rope. “What good was an artist if he couldn’t make his art?” Wandering around during a thunderstorm in the hopes of curing his crippling creative block, master potter Lucas Duncan is surprised to find something else—a terrified and lost cat. He’s even more surprised to discover who the owner is: the handsome newcomer to town. “I didn’t want to believe that I could feel that way about another man…” Deep in the closet and ten years Chris’s senior, Lucas wouldn’t normally have a reason to associate with the young wanderer… if not for Henry the cat, and the unyielding magnetism of fate. Can the undeniable connection between the two lost souls bring their stray hearts home? Stray Hearts is a 40,000-word standalone contemporary gay romance, complete with lots of heat and a happily ever after ending.

When Roman Notaro slammed Bellamy Colbert against the boards in a playoff game that rewrote both their careers, the league crowned its villains and heroes.

Bellamy is the golden boy, franchise face, the captain-in-waiting, and he plays hockey as if it’s an art form. Roman is the chaos king. Violent and reckless, but also brilliant and impossible to ignore. The hate between them sparks instantly.

Then Bellamy’s longtime captain retires, and the team trades for Roman. Suddenly, the league’s most explosive rivals are skating the same line and fighting for the same captaincy. Fans pick sides, media fuels the fire, and even their coach calls it a competition.

Roman and Bellamy think it’s a war. They clash on the ice, in the locker room, and in every interview that pits them against each other, but under the rivalry, there’s something else brewing.

As old wounds resurface and the pressure becomes unbearable, the line between enemy and ally blurs, and hatred turns to heat, because when two gods collide, something always breaks.

And this time, it might be them.

NEIMUS GRUNDLY TAKES the reigns and becomes the new alpha of an elite order of werewolves. His first day on the job isn’t going so well. He has to deal with his hybrid wolf problem, the werecats, angry witches, and the moral decline amongst his subordinates.

Oliver Grimes, one of his wolves, has discovered a way to gift magic. After bestowing himself with powers, Oliver can now create hybrid werewolves with a single bite, putting the pedigree of the pack in jeopardy. Thereby forcing Neimus to call upon the pack physician, who has been separated from the pack for 950 years, to help rid them of hybrid werewolves.

In conjunction, Neimus has to walk a fine line with Phelan, the alpha of the werecats, with whom they are on the verge of war. The werecats attacks are more frequent and deadly, but Neimus fears the growing threat of the witches the most. He is thrust into uncharted territory. He must find a way to safely get his pack through these trying times. A challenge he isn’t sure he can manage.

He’s the sport’s “safe” star—clean image, pretty girlfriend, sponsors who love him.
I’m the out fighter everyone treats like a headline.

When a sparring clip goes viral, the promoter sells it as a grudge: bad blood, big mouths, fight-night fireworks. We play our parts in public—until the thing we’re pretending to hate turns into the only place either of us can breathe.

But he can only want me in the dark.

And I’m done being anyone’s secret.

BELOW THE BELT is a steamy MM boxing romance packed with rivals-to-lovers tension, a forced “bad blood” storyline, secret hookups, jealous heat, found-family gym vibes, and a hard-won, public happily-ever-after.

The player he was supposed to hate becomes the only person he can't live without.

They've been rivals since junior hockey - Jax Mercer, Canada's golden boy, and Viktor Sokolov, the Russian outsider with nothing to lose but everything to prove. On the ice, they're competitors. In the dark, they're something else entirely.

When they're forced into proximity at the World Junior Championships, their antagonism becomes obsession. Secret encounters. Touches in hallways when no one's watching. A connection neither of them can name or deny. But proximity doesn't last forever.

Drafted to different teams, separated by continent and circumstance, Jax tells himself it was just the pressure of the moment - desire without permission, heat without consequence. Viktor, who has learned never to trust what he cannot control, buries it deeper.

Then the trade happens. Same team. Same city. The collision they thought they'd escaped becomes inevitable.

On the ice, their chemistry is undeniable - a pairing so synchronized it borders on supernatural. Off the ice, they're forced to confront what they've been hiding: a need for each other that rivals their ambition, a connection forged in secrecy that neither of them knows how to survive.

Because this time, there's no distance to protect them. No separation to make forgetting possible. Just the terrible, irresistible gravity of two people who can't stay away, even when staying close might destroy them both.

Seven years in prison. One rule to stay free. Don’t touch the boss’s son.

Connor I’m thirty-five, fresh out of prison, and walking a razor’s edge. Probation is simple: Curfew. Routine inspections. No mistakes. The McGrath Ranch was supposed to be my quiet place to disappear. The owner is old-school, strict, and looking for a reason to cut me loose. Then Ryder shows up. He’s twenty-two, all sunshine grins and dangerous rebellion. He rides like he’s invincible and looks at me like he wants to be ruined. He calls me "Sir" with a smile that makes it hard to breathe. I know the risks. One slip, one accusation, and I’m back in a cell. But when we’re alone in the barn, keeping my hands to myself feels like a crime.

Ryder I live my life in a cage made of my father’s expectations. Brand the calves. Say grace. Be the perfect heir. Connor is the only thing on this ranch that feels real. He’s scarred, silent, and terrifyingly controlled. I want to provoke him. I want to see the man beneath the discipline. In the daylight, we ignore each other. In the dark, he ties me down and sets me free. He protects me. He owns me. But if my father finds out, I lose my home. And Connor loses his freedom.

Welcome to McGrath Ranch. Where the fences are high, the secrets are heavy, and the forbidden fruit tastes like freedom.

Wide Open Country features: 🤠 Ex-Con x Boss’s Son 🔥 Age Gap (35/22) ⛓️ Power Dynamics & Rope Play 🤫 Strictly Forbidden ⚡ "Touch Him and Die" Energy

He calls the pitches. He calls his bluff.

Veteran catcher Theo Morales has one job: make chaos look like strategy. New ace Jax Calder pitches like a lit match—electric, beautiful, and one mistake from burning it all down. When a blind item turns a routine road trip into a media circus, the franchise’s quiet captain and its loudest star are forced into a truce built on game plans, double-taps, and an unspoken I’ve got you.

Winning in October takes boring, repeatable excellence. Wanting each other is anything but. Between hot mics, tunnel confrontations, and a hotel mix-up with one king bed and too many cameras, Theo and Jax learn a new language—of signs, trust, and the changeup Jax hates until he loves it. But rumors don’t care about chemistry, and one bad inning can cost a season…or the only person who finally feels like home.

Baseball is numbers. Love is nerve. To survive both, they’ll have to choose the right pitch when it matters most.

Fourth And Goal

A SPICY GAY FOOTBALL ROMANCE

Fourth and Goal is a sizzling, slow-burn, emotionally charged gay sports romance that blends high-stakes football with tender vulnerability, second chances, and the kind of chemistry that hits harder than any tackle on the field.

Evan Marshall is America’s Quarterback—iconic, adored, and trapped. At 28, the world believes he has it all: fame, fortune, a spotless public image, and the strongest arm in professional football. But behind the confident interviews and carefully controlled smile lies a man terrified of losing everything if the truth about him ever slips through the cracks.

James “Jimmy” Lawson walked away from football years ago, choosing authenticity over the suffocating pressure of the league. Now a beloved high-school history teacher and part-time coach, he’s built a quiet, contented life in his hometown. But when a documentary crew invites him to appear in a special episode featuring his old college teammate—the man he once loved from afar—Jimmy’s life is thrown into chaos.

When Evan and Jimmy reunite for the documentary, sparks are immediate—and undeniable. What begins as awkward tension quickly becomes magnetic pull. Evan is still that charismatic golden boy, impossible to resist, and Jimmy is still the only person who’s ever seen the man behind the myth.

As filming forces the two back into each other’s orbit, old feelings resurface—along with new desire neither of them can ignore. Evan, once terrified of being seen, begins to crave the very things that scare him most: honesty, intimacy, and the comfort of Jimmy’s steady presence. Jimmy, long resigned to watching Evan from a distance, finds himself falling all over again. And this time, Evan falls too.

But being together means confronting every fear Evan has spent a decade burying—paparazzi, public scrutiny, loss of endorsement deals, and a fanbase that believes they own him. For Jimmy, it means risking the peaceful life he’s built. For both men, it means choosing a love that refuses to be sidelined.

With steamy tension, heartfelt vulnerability, and the pulse-pounding excitement of professional football, Fourth and Goal delivers a romance full of heat, humor, tenderness, courage—and the kind of love story that readers of Rachel Reid, Sarina Bowen, and Tal Bauer devour.

This is a story about two men who have spent their lives running from what they want most…until each other becomes the one thing they can’t let go.

Can a former jock and nerd with two broken hearts find a way to mend it into one?

Brandon:

Kevin was my everything. He was my first kiss, my first lover, and my first boyfriend. His piercing blue eyes, shoulder-length blonde hair, and ripped basketball physique were the eye candy I needed to get through my rigorous academic day. He was the man I would spend the rest of my life with, but everything changed when his teammate Robbie caught us about to make love. The affectionate, bi-curious guy disappeared, and a closeted angry jock replaced him. After that, my life was never the same.

So, when I saw him for the first time after ten years, I wanted to hurt and love him simultaneously. I realized I hadn't fully healed from the pain he’d caused me ten years ago, and I was finally going to confront him about it, and I was going to make him listen.

Kevin:

Ten years ago, I acted out of panic and did something I'll never forgive myself for. The rumors I spread and the lies I told about Brandon reflected my insecurity. I was young, closeted, immature, and didn't know who I was.

In an interesting turn of events, the universe brought us together, and to my surprise, he transformed into a muscular, handsome Adonis with a sexy after-five shadow. I knew fate was giving me a second chance to correct my past, and I would do whatever it took to win his heart back.

Can these two former lovers work through their pain and rediscover love? Will Brandon forgive Kevin, or will he get revenge? Find out what happens in this mm enemies to lovers, bi-awakening steamy, high-heat prison romance that ends in an HEA.

Baxter Rawlins: a real heartbreaker.

He broke my heart ten years ago.

Back in high school, Baxter pretended he didn't know me. I was a skinny, plaid-shirt-wearing nobody. I was openly gay, but nobody even cared — except Baxter, when he wanted a hookup.

That was all a nerd like me could expect from the star quarterback and prom king. He treated me as his shameful secret.

I’m older now. Wiser. I know I deserve better. But I can't stop wishing for another fleeting moment in Baxter's embrace.

Andy Silver: my one weakness.

Every time Andy smiled at me from under his floppy hair, I couldn’t help myself. How could a nerd in wire-rimmed glasses be so hot?

It was a high school fling. I spent ten years running away from it. I couldn't live the life I wanted, even if I loved Andy more than he ever knew.

Bumping into Andy ten years later was the shock of my life. That shy nerd is a celebrity now? And he works out?

I shouldn’t dwell on how much I miss being with him, even if every sight of him sends me there.

I came back to Honey Bay for business. I might stay for a second chance at love.

Remember Him is a 42,000-word second-chance gay romance. On their way to a feel-good happy ever after, a jock and a nerd dodge windmill blades, fog up the windows, and discuss the fine points of timber, lumber, and plain old wood.

Wrenched: Part 1 of a 3-part series

Beau likes things simple: engines, grease, and silence. The garage is his world, and he doesn’t let anyone in. Not anymore.

Jesse is a stranger in town—clean-cut, quiet, and clearly running from something. He’s never worked a day with his hands, but desperation puts him in Beau’s path.

They’re nothing alike. Beau is older, rough, and built from scars. Jesse is younger, lost, and hiding truths he can’t say out loud. But long hours in the shop turn into something more. A touch that lingers. A look that burns. A connection neither man expected.

Theirs is a love story that doesn’t come polished. It’s raw. Messy. Hard-won.

And once they give in, there’s no turning back.

WRENCHED is the first book in Dirty Hands, a gritty, high-heat MM romance trilogy about blue-collar men, broken pasts, and the kind of love that leaves a mark.

Sam is turning seventeen and he's pushed towards adulthood too fast. He has a whole bunch of grown-up problems now and it's been giving him a headache. So while temping at a summer camp, Sam finds himself gravitating towards Eric–a little daredevil who introduces him to fun things, like stealing, lying, drinking, smoking, and having sex.? And even though things like that can lead you into even more trouble, Sam remains blissfully unaware and is headed towards a disaster. Somebody is just going to have to show him the right way.

Handymen in flannel, Hollywood stars, steamy romps, found family, and a town that will go to extremes for its residents.

Firefly wasn’t a vacation. It was an escape.

Nobody warned me about the bed and breakfast owners with opinions, the grocery store lady with questions, or the strip teases for charity. In Hollywood, nobody cares who you are. In Firefly Valley, nobody cares who you were.

Then there’s the rugged flannel wearing handyman with absolutely zero interest in my IMDb page.

Bobby protects my ego from the media by pretending to be my boyfriend. He’s the calm in a storm, and I’m not hating our fake relationship, which is the most unsettling thing that’s ever happened. And I’ve survived three tabloid scandals.

The role of a lifetime is still on the table. Bobby’s still in Firefly. And for the first time, I want to ignore opportunity and follow my heart.

Lennox Sanders

I have no clue what happened with Dane.

The last thing I remember is the night we graduated from high school.

Twelve years later, we’re both living in San Diego.

He can’t stand to look at me, and I can’t stand to stay away.

I have to know what he’s hiding, and I’ll stop at nothing to find out.

Lieutenant Dane Calloway

Lennox wants me back in his life. But I walked away from my former best friend and our plans for a reason.

He wants to know what happened, but I think he knows.

I hate him, and he lives to irritate the f*ck out of me.

And I’m not giving in even though it’s all I want to do.

Illegal Formation is a childhood best friends to one-sided enemies to lovers Sports Romance. It is book two in the San Diego Storm Series. Tropes include grumpy sunshine, hurt comfort, humor with low to medium angst.

When visiting scholar Evan Austen arrives at Oxford to study ancient manuscripts, he's drawn by more than academic curiosity—something in the city calls to him like a half-remembered dream.

Dr. Arthur Byrne has walked Oxford's shadowed corridors for four centuries, hiding his vampiric nature behind a succession of false identities. But when he catches Evan's scent in the Bodleian Library, he recognizes the impossible: the soul of his lost love Alexandro, who died in Venice in 1623 during a failed immortality ritual.

As Evan experiences vivid dreams of Renaissance Venice and discovers he can read languages no living person should know, he and Arthur uncover a terrible truth—Evan isn't just Alexandro reincarnated, but something unprecedented. The failed ritual that killed him created a bridge between mortal and immortal, human and vampire, binding their souls across death itself.

Their search for the Codex Sanguinarius, a legendary text containing the complete transformation ritual, takes them from Oxford's ancient libraries to the ruins beneath Istanbul. But with each passing day, as Evan's memories awaken and Arthur's heart begins to beat again in his presence, they must decide: risk everything on a second attempt at transformation, or accept the brief decades a mortal life will allow them?

A gothic romance of eternal love and second chances, Dead Languages weaves passion and scholarship, desire and destiny, into a darkly sensual tale of two souls who refuse to let death have the final word.

When Gabriel Moreau's brother disappears with a half-million-dollar debt to the mob, Gabe offers the only thing he has of value—himself.

Executive chef and owner of a small French bistro, Gabe has spent three years building his dream from nothing. But when dangerous men destroy his kitchen demanding payment for his brother's gambling debts, he finds himself standing face-to-face with Lucian Rossi—the youngest mob boss in the city, who accepts Gabe's offer to work off the debt as his personal chef.

Lucian rules his criminal empire with cold precision and an iron fist. He doesn't do attachments, doesn't show weakness, and definitely doesn't fall for mouthy chefs who refuse to be intimidated. But Gabe cooks like an artist, argues like an equal, and looks at Lucian like he's just a man, not a monster.

As rival families circle and betrayal threatens from within, their arrangement turns into something neither expected. Every shared meal brings them closer, every threat pulls them together, and every kiss tastes like danger. But in Lucian's world, love is a luxury that could get them both killed.

When the violence escalates and Gabe becomes a target, they must decide: Is what they've found worth the blood they'll have to spill to keep it?

A scorching MM mafia romance about a chef who brings flavor to a mob boss's life—and might just bring him to his knees.

Content warning: Violence, organized crime, hurt/comfort, and more Italian food than is strictly necessary.

A private club. Anonymous. No names and masks on. He catches my eye and we meet every week. I fall hard and fast each time we’re together. And now…I’m in love. Silly, right? I mean, I don’t even know what he looks like.

Then I discover he’s superstar college quarterback Patrick “Trick” Sloane. On his way to playing professional football. I’ll never be anything but his dirty little secret. So I leave without saying good-bye.

Ten years later, Patrick is the quarterback of the Brooklyn Kings with a wild reputation as a ladies’ man, and I’m his new personal assistant. Patrick doesn’t know I was once his lover, but I’ve never forgotten him. To complicate matters, in spite of my best efforts to keep things strictly business, we’ve become friends.

Then one night, our past catches up with our present, and old love is new again. Patrick isn’t willing to give up football…or me. I don’t want him to risk everything he’s worked his whole life for. I can wait.

But Patrick makes a bold decision that will change everything. It could either be the end of us…or a beautiful beginning.

False Start is a second chance, reunited lovers MM romance that proves ten years apart can't stop what's meant to be.

Whoever convinced me to join the gym needs to be hung, drawn, and quartered. Or, at the very least, suffer with a pillow hot on both sides every night, because this? This is terrible.

Running? No thank you.

Lifting? Who needs biceps anyway.

Now, I will say the eye-candy is nice. Especially my new personal trainer with the tattoos and dimples. But that’s all he can ever be: eye candy.

Because he’s fit and I’m not.

He’s gorgeous and I’m, well, me.

He’s hearing…and I’m Deaf.

For some people that might not be an issue, but for me, I have rules. And I’m a stubborn man who will not break them, not even for that sexy crooked smile that almost makes me forget my own name.

But I don’t date men who can’t speak my language, and while we can say plenty with our bodies, that’s where our communication ends.

Still, the longer I spend with him, the more I’m starting to realize there may be more to this relationship than frantic, feral office hook-ups. After all, he might be the first hearing person to learn sign for me. And he’s one of the first people I’ve ever known to make me feel worthy.

So maybe, just maybe, that’s worth a little compromise.

Heartthrob George wants to prove he's smart enough to graduate. Nerdy Lucas wants to finally ask his crush out. They strike a deal to get what they want . . . but they may accidentally splash into a row-mance together in this queer, sports rom-com.

George and Lucas can’t stand each other—which makes it very awkward being on the same Cambridge University rowing team. The uber-charming, all-American George got accepted at Cambridge for his sporting prowess, not his subpar grades. Economics whizz and sarcasm expert Lucas, meanwhile, works hard for everything he’s got, which sadly does not include a boyfriend.

When the news leaks that George receives academic preferential treatment—Cambridge couldn’t lose their star athlete, after all—he’s told he must actually study this year to pass his exams. That’s when he zeroes in on Lucas for help. Lucas agrees, but on one condition: George will teach Lucas his lothario ways so he can finally seduce his long-time crush, Amir.

But soon they're in way over their heads, seducing and cheating their way to what they want. As they face rivals within their own squad and cutthroat competitors at Oxford, they find themselves unexpectedly becoming closer. What happens when your worst enemy may just be who you needed all along?

A Romantic Hockey Comedy

Hockey. Drama. Battles on and off the ice.

Jack

I had my person I was supposed to grow old with, but he double broke my heart when he forced me to choose between marrying him or hockey. I chose hockey and if I’m choosing hockey, I’m doing it all the way and leaving love out of the equation. Sounds like a great plan until I show up to hockey practice and realize the guy I fell into bed with is actually my new coach.

Mercy

People depend on me. They need me. Worrying about myself has always come last. That’s what my life has been about since I was ten years old. That is until I decided to take what I wanted just once. Now, my heart’s decided Jack’s mine. I’ve fallen and I’ll never be the same. There’s just one problem. He’s on my hockey team and I can’t avoid him. I’m drawn to him like a moth to a flame. What do you do when you know in your heart someone’s yours, but you can’t have them?

This real Canadian adventure features possessive MCs, an age-gap romance, enemies-to-lovers vibes, and the sweetest gay hockey romance you’ll ever listen to.

It's a wild ride from start to finish with hilarious characters who do outrageous things. Oh, and of course, it contains the caretaking dynamic Mock (S. Legend and Canadian) is known best for. It’s a verified member of the Hot Pink Peaches Club.

A male prostitute, a mangy cat, a murder, and an obsession that threatens his career, his impending marriage and his life...nothing is going as planned for Austin Glass.

Austin Glass seems to have it all: a loving fiancée, a future with the FBI, and a healthy-sized trust fund. At least on the surface. He also has a grin and a wisecrack for every situation. But the smile he presents to the world hides a painful past he’s buried too deeply to remember, and his quips mask bitterness and insecurity. Austin has himself and most of the whole world fooled - until he meets a redhead in a pair of bunny slippers.

As events unfold in the biggest case of his life, Austin’s carefully planned future unravels, and he finds himself pushed into making quick, life-changing decisions. But can he trust himself or anything he feels, when each event seems to be just a series of volatile reactions?

When Ryan is hijacked and stolen away from Alexander, the Master realizes he’s neglected some important training with his slave and it leads to disaster. Alexander can’t wait any longer for Ryan to become more submissive and he puts his slave in training with Raunchy.

Charlie
I’m tired.
My life has been filled with disappointments, sadness, and pain.
I’m hated by everyone besides my best friend. Until the captain of the hockey team falls on top of me. His eyes are as blue as the ice he plays on, and his smile fills me with warmth I’ve never felt before.
Shane Hawkins.
The man everyone’s friends with, now has me in his sights and he’s not showing any signs of letting me go. Even through my anxiety and messed up mind, he’s still there.
And I don’t understand why.
But it doesn’t matter. Everyone leaves me when the monsters in my head become too loud.

Shane
When I started at Gannon University, my main goal was to focus on hockey and be drafted into the NHL.
But that all changed the day I collided with the most beautiful man I’ve ever seen. His golden-brown eyes held such sadness and pain that I couldn’t rest until I saw him again.
Charlie Alexander.
The gifted artist with a mind full of demons and a secret I want to uncover.
He tries to hide them from me, but I see him. His struggle ignites my instinct to protect him.
When he returns from a trip home, broken and bloody, I do everything I can to show him the goodness in life.
But sometimes that’s not enough.

Nathan Reed's inheritance came with a catch: thirty days on his late uncle's Montana ranch before he can sell it and escape back to his cushy Chicago corner office.

The last thing this city-slicker omega needs is six feet of rugged, scowling alpha cowboy judging his designer boots and manicured hands.

Ranch foreman Ethan Brody has no patience for entitled urbanites who wouldn't know a heifer from a steer. Especially infuriatingly attractive ones who plan to sell the land he loves to developers.

But when a suspicious fire forces them to work together, the sizzling tension between them erupts into something neither expected—a heat-fueled night that leaves more than just memories behind.

Now Nathan's facing an unexpected pregnancy, a ruthless land developer breathing down their necks, and the terrifying possibility that the freedom he's always craved might actually be the last thing he needs.

The ranch might be his inheritance, but the cowboy is claiming his heart.

Cowboy's City Slicker Omega is a standalone contemporary M/M mpreg romance with no shifter elements. It features a stubborn alpha ranch foreman with calloused hands and a protective streak, a city-bred omega financial analyst discovering what truly matters, enemies-to-lovers tension, a surprise pregnancy, ranch rivalries, found family, small-town charm, protective alpha instincts, satisfying nesting scenes, passionate claiming, and a guaranteed HEA. This non-shifter omegaverse romance delivers all the heart and heat of rural Montana with none of the fur. If you love fish-out-of-water romances where opposites attract and city meets country, one-click today!

From the USA Today bestselling author of BOYFRIEND MATERIAL and HUSBAND MATERIAL comes a charming New Adult LGBTQIA+ romance perfect for fans of Heartstopper.
Drew’s always prided himself on being the “right” kind of nerd. He plays sports, has a solid group of friends, and never had any problem talking to girls. Sure, he spends time playing Heroes of Legend, the biggest MMORPG on the planet, but it’s just a fun hobby, not his identity. Falling for someone in a video game? Not his style.
Until it is.
Enter Kit: witty, kind, razor-sharp, and a healer who’s saved Drew’s virtual skin more times than he can count. She’s also, turns out, a boy in real life. The realization knocks Drew off-balance, but it doesn’t take long for him to figure out the simple truth—he likes Kit, no matter Kit’s gender.
The real challenge? Kit’s reality is leagues apart from Drew’s. Being online is his life, and while he’s willing to come out of his shell an inch at a time, there’s such a wide gulf between them that Drew’s left wondering: can love truly bridge the distance…or are they fated to remain in separate worlds forever?

When world-famous surfer-turned-model Kai Silverwood—gorgeous, untouchable, and hiding a feral secret—steps in front of Garrett James’s camera, sparks ignite hotter than the California sun. Garrett, a struggling photographer with an eye for beauty and a hunger for more, can’t look away from the wild intensity beneath Kai’s perfect façade.

But as his lens captures Kai in intimate, unguarded moments, Garrett uncovers more than just raw desire—he catches glimpses of the beast that lurks beneath the man. Instead of fear, fascination takes hold, pulling him into a dangerous, delicious game of temptation and trust.

Now every sultry look, every daring touch, every “accidental” brush of skin blurs the line between work and pleasure. And Garrett is about to find out just how wild the world’s most beautiful wolf can get when the sun goes down.

A fairy prince in hiding. A human who didn’t sign up for this.

When my landlord said I’d be getting a roommate to help cover rent, I didn’t expect him.

Auren shows up with designer luggage, a crown-shaped dent in his hair, and absolutely no idea how to function like a normal human. He can’t work the washing machine, burns water trying to boil it, and keeps accidentally summoning flower petals every time he sneezes.

Oh, and he’s apparently some kind of fairy prince “undercover” in the mortal world.

Sharing an apartment with him is a nightmare. A gorgeous, sparkly, maddening nightmare.

But the longer he stays, the harder it is to stay annoyed. Especially when he starts asking for “lessons” on how to blend in. Lessons that somehow include teaching him how to use the subway, how to order takeout… and what humans usually do when they’re sharing a bed.

I told myself I wasn’t going to get involved. But between the way he looks at me when I say his name and the fact that he somehow keeps ending up in my lap, I think I’m the one who’s in over my head.

Their love blazes bright. But can it survive the shadows of the past?

Jaden Andrews thought he had it all—Daryl’s love, Juilliard’s stage, and a chance to finally move on. But starting fresh isn’t easy when everyone remembers the scandal that nearly destroyed him.

Daryl Wright wants to believe their love is enough. Yet every step Jaden takes into his new world at Juilliard feels like a step away from him. And Miles, Jaden’s confident, flirty classmate, is everything Daryl isn’t—young, free, and unburdened by the past.

As jealousy, temptation, and old mistakes threaten to tear them apart, Jaden and Daryl must face the hardest question of all:

Is love strong enough to outlast the fire, or will it burn them both to ashes?

"Showmance is ready for the big time....Beguelin crafts a story you never want to end.” —Steven Rowley, New York Times bestselling author of The Celebrants

A down-on-his-luck Broadway playwright is marooned in rural Illinois in this sharply funny queer rom-com

Noah Adams’s career as a playwright is circling the drain, thanks to a scorching review of his first Broadway musical. So when a family emergency sends him back to his Podunk hometown of Plainview, Illinois, he figures he’ll hide out for a bit. But to Noah’s horror, his agent has secretly arranged for him to stage an amateur version of the career-ruining musical at the local community theater.

As if trying to work with a bunch of artless amateurs wasn’t enough, Noah runs into Luke, the jerk from his high school years, everywhere he goes. Luke somehow grew up to be beloved by everyone in town…and undeniably gorgeous. As rehearsals begin, Noah is surprised by his cast’s insights, the warmth of the town he’d dismissed, and the reality of what happened with Luke all those years ago. Just how much has Noah misjudged?

"Everything you’d ever want a rom com to be.” —Hannah Grace, #1 New York Times bestselling author of Icebreaker

Catching flights . . . and feelings.

Asher Bennett thought his relationship was just fine. Until he’s unceremoniously dumped at the Boston airport ahead of The Epic Trek, the worldwide travel competition reality show. Armed with only a ticket and righteous indignation, Asher finds solace at an airport TGI Fridays. Luckily, right in front of him is a smooth-talking airline pilot ready for takeoff.

Theo Fernandez has been grounded. He’s the only pilot that has never taken a vacation and the edict has been passed down: Prove you're prioritizing work-life balance or say goodbye to your wings. Struggling to bask in his new downtime, he stumbles upon the perfect opportunity. The handsome guy at his favorite terminal eatery has a sudden opening for a partner . . . on a nationally televised reality show.

As Theo and Asher buckle up to fake date for the cameras, the undercurrents of attraction make them wonder if their on-screen chemistry hints at something bigger. But do they have the courage to leave their baggage behind for another chance at love?

Owen I never thought I'd come home to Wish Creek. I've made a lot of mistakes. The kind of mistakes you have to run from, and the only place I can run is home. On the last stretch of highway, I meet him: Rhett Vance, my high school crush. He never noticed me back then, but now I have a second chance. He's changed. So have I. The only thing that hasn't changed is my absolute and intense desire to be his man. Problem is: I don't think he's gay. Let's see if I can change that, and forget all those problems I'm running from. Rhett I'm not gay, right? Why can't I stop staring at Owen? I pick him up on the side of the road. He seems lost. He needs a friend, or a lover. I haven't seen him in so long, but the instant he sets foot in my truck, we connect. It's magic. It's love. This chance meeting makes me totally rethink who I am. I want him. Badly. But who can I tell? Do I have to carry this secret, or can I love Owen openly? He has his own secrets. Why has he come back to Wish Creek after so long? Can I trust him? Can I love him? I don't have any other choice! He's hiding something. I have to know what it is. I have to kiss him. I have to hold him. Owen James is a mystery and I intend to solve it, and when I do, I know my life is going to change. Naked Truth is the first standalone novel in the Men of Wish Creek series, about a sleepy little Midwest town where men from all walks of life are looking for love, and sometimes they find it with each other! Naked Truth features a high level of heat and a guaranteed HEA.

"A sexy romance and a dramatic story.”

"A love story about a gay president and the second in command that he adores."

A bachelor auction, a secret crush, and a chance to finally claim what was never supposed to be mine.

I didn’t see it coming.
Not Liam Hart, striding back into my life after twelve years looking buffer, harder, and cooler than ever.
And...Okay, I'll admit it, hotter.
My brother’s best friend. The guy I used to idolize. The guy I convinced myself I just wanted to be like —even when I sent him that late-night message before he shipped out, practically begging for a reply I never got.

Now, I’m opening my first store, living my dream in Chicago, and still playing it straight.
Until Luca slinks in, throwing himself at Liam and reminding me that Liam isn’t just any guy—he’s the guy.
The one guy I never could get over.

And when Liam ends up on stage at a bachelor auction? Game over. I don’t even think. I just bid. Hard.

Now, I’ve got Liam Hart in my bed, in my hands, and in my life. And the more he lets me in, the harder it is to remember why I shouldn’t want him. Why I tried to play it straight at all. Because when he looks at me the way he does, when he touches me like he can’t get enough… I start to believe I might just be his.

I don’t know where this is going. All I know is, I can’t walk away from him now. Not when he’s finally within reach.

Disclaimer: The Crush Do-Over, a scorching, tender, and totally unplanned romance includes auction shenanigans, a little bit of jealousy, and one best friend’s brother who never saw it coming but can’t look away now. Expect intense longing, heated moments, and a couple of clueless fools who are about to find out that what they wanted was right in front of them all along.

How does a Texan male prostitute find love in a world filled with paid sex and drugs?

Toby is strikingly handsome and on the outside, he seems to have it all. He has an array of acquaintances, plenty of money and a cat who adopted him. When he meets Jakob - a handsome gay Danish guy, he is attracted to his innocence and those piercing-blue eyes. Then Ariana enters his life - a successful and beautiful woman from New York - and he begins to picture an idyllic lifestyle with such a woman. He is drawn in by her energy and her success.

Both Ariana and Jakob have dark pasts to rival his own. One of them will be deadly

. Can Toby make the right decision and finally put his own ghosts to rest? Will Jakob or Ariana be enough for Toby to start the life he's only ever dreamed of?

I’ve been alone long enough.

As a chart-topping country singer, I’m living the dream. While my family is all back in Austin, embracing their happily-ever-afters, I’m on the road on a sold-out tour.

I should feel ecstatic, yet all I am is lonely.

Maybe that’s why I find myself drawn to a fan who pops up at one of my shows. Something about the way he watches me on stage has me thinking…he knows my secret. And after the first kiss, I can’t seem to let him go. But Jensen Miles has some secrets of his own:

He isn’t just a regular fan. He’s a preacher.

And not just any preacher—the new preacher at my dad’s church.

Where I come from, preachers don’t have filthy mouths and dirty hookups, let alone with a male country singer.

But Jensen has scars like mine. They just run deeper.

We can’t stay away from each other, though. One night turns into nearly every city of the tour; the two of us sneak around backstage, onto tour buses, and in hotel rooms. And while I’ve never been happier…I’m tired of hiding.

With Jensen, I might be able to escape the monsters from my past—even if the scariest one has just been set free. With Jensen, we can outrun our demons together.

With Jensen, I’m finally ready to come home.

Darkness sleeps beneath Barrowdeep.

War-weary mercenary Leoric has traded his sword for a shovel, burying the undead blight that plagues the little town of Barrowdeep. Now he fights for the living instead of against them.

Fae trickster Orphium travels from town to town, stealing human trinkets and memories through games of chance. He's desperate to fill the hollow in his heart, but the hunger never goes away.

Barrowdeep is ripe for the picking, except the nosy local gravedigger keeps interfering. But when Leoric unearths an ancient fae artifact, Orphium knows he’ll stop at nothing to possess the powerful coin.

And the undead will stop at nothing to possess him.

Orphium and Leoric must fight the undead together before tensions and their shadowy pasts rise to the surface — and before an even darker evil awakens beneath Barrowdeep.

Grave Misfortune is a part of the multi-author series, Fortune Favors the Fae. From spicy to sweet, zany romps to epic adventures, there’s something for everyone in this mystical series. Discover destiny and true love and follow the coin on its fickle journey to the next world and a new magical adventure.

Bastian has never belonged to anyone, and he doesn’t expect a bit of pet training and an event at a pretty resort to change that. In fact, the only reason he came at all is that his best friend, Chauncy, was too shy to come on his own. Chauncy has dreams of becoming the perfect pet for some special person, while Bastian couldn’t imagine ever allowing anyone to change him. He loves who he is and is proud to be a little rough around the edges and a teensy bit wild. That’s not saying he doesn’t want a keeper; he just has no interest in a master who wants to bend him to his will.

Jarrod is the gentle, give them their heads and let them run with it type. As the pony master, he’s developed a soft hand and tends to coax rather than make demands. He’s never seriously looked at a pet that wasn’t a pony though, and Bastian, in his cute, fuzzy and form-fitting ferret suit, is about as far from being a pony as one can get. Yet when Jarrod spies him summersault off the back of a bench and hit the ground running, he’s intrigued. He hasn’t spied this particular pet moving in and out of the training rooms, nor has he seen him hanging around with any of the other trainees. Of course, he can’t be everywhere, so there’s a pretty good chance he’s missed him, but now that he’s had a glimpse, he knows he’ll never forget that stunning face or lithe athleticism. Unfortunately for him, Bastian does an immediate about-face when he hears the word master and makes himself impossible for Jarrod to find.

He's determined though, especially when he learns that Bastian comes down to the lobby before sunrise every morning, reading until light brightens the sky enough for him to make his daily run. Step one, be there on the trail to join him. Will Bastian take the time to learn that Jarrod is only firm when it comes to his pet’s needs and well-being, or will he rush past him in his hurry to fling himself off the next obstacle, and miss out on the one trainer perfectly suited to him?

Dante “Diesel” Cruz is the fiercest underground fighter in Chicago — inked, jaded, and completely untouchable. His rule? No attachments. Ever.

Logan Chase is the golden boy of the city’s elite gym scene — a clean-cut personal trainer with a body built for sin and a heart he’s tried too hard to guard.

When Logan gets recruited to secretly train Dante for a shot at a legit championship, sparks fly. Logan isn’t ready for Diesel’s dangerous world. And Diesel isn’t ready for someone who actually gives a damn.

But fists aren’t the only things flying in the ring.

As their sessions grow hotter and their connection deeper, secrets unravel, punches land, and trust gets tested. Because when love throws the first punch, nothing is safe — not hearts, not bones, and definitely not rules.

Only one thing is certain: When these two collide, someone’s going down.

Ten years ago, Elias Hart and River Quinn were the kind of boys who believed love could rewrite the stars. Best friends turned high school sweethearts, they made a secret vow beneath the full moon on the cliffs of their sleepy coastal hometown: no matter what, we find our way back to each other.

Then River left. No goodbye. No explanation. Just a shattered promise and silence.

Now Elias is back in Tidesway Bay, caring for his ailing father and trying to outrun the ghosts of a past that won’t let go. The last person he expects to see? River—older, quieter, and still heartbreakingly beautiful.

But River’s carrying secrets. Guilt. And a truth that could change everything Elias thought he knew.

As the two are forced into each other’s orbit—renovating the town’s crumbling observatory, navigating old wounds, and trying not to fall back into everything that almost destroyed them—they begin to realize: maybe the moon wasn’t done with them yet.

This ultra-bundle contains eight steamy hot Dickson EM gay bro romance short stories and novellas—The entire author collection! Get it now for one fantastic price! Titles: BEST BRO'S GAY HALFTIME BEST BRO'S NEW TOYS BEST BRO'S CAMSHOW BEST BRO'S HARD WORKOUT BRO'S LOCKER ROOM SECRET BRO'S FIRST DORM NIGHT BRO'S LONG RIDE RIPTIDE

Brett and Shane are just two coworkers sent to an out-of-town conference to launch their company’s latest software app. But when a flight delay leaves them stranded for an extra night, forcing them to share a hotel room, what started as casual banter over beers takes an unexpected turn. Shane always knew he was different but never acted on his desires. As the two men explore new boundaries, Shane finds himself wrestling with emotions he can’t ignore, torn between desire and the need to protect his heart.

In this steamy MM novella, the men explore their urges together, navigating uncharted and complex waters of friendship, bisexuality, and a few other surprises along the way. Brett and Shane are about to discover that life is about experiences and that sometimes the most unexpected situations are the ones worth extending—just like their hotel stay.

Warning: This novella contains explicit sexual content between two men.

Tanner, a fun-loving American jock, is on a solo trip through Europe, eager for adventure but struggling with the language. What was meant to be a simple coffee stop in Paris turns into a whirlwind of spontaneity when he crosses paths with Frederick, a charming and stylish Frenchman. Despite their language barrier, an unexpected spark ignites between them.

Using a quirky translation app, Tanner and Frederick embark on an unforgettable weekend filled with fun, passion, and discovery. As they explore the hidden gems of Paris and navigate their growing connection, their bond deepens in ways words could never express.

But as their time together draws to a close, Tanner makes a bold proposal that could change everything: an open road to new adventures and unknown possibilities. Will Frederick take the leap?

The French Connection is a heartwarming novella about seizing the moment, embracing spontaneity, and finding a connection where you least expect it.

Part II of LOVE SUCKS: New York Stories of Love, Hate and Anonymous Sex, the Gay Men’s Press bestseller from the nineties, now reprinted in electronic form. A guided tour through sleaze city, this reportage walks the thin line between journalism and fiction. From Bottoms Up to One Bitch's Story each chapter takes you one step further to a place you'd rather not go. A book to hide under your pillow. So hold your nose.

Don’t Ask. Don’t Tell. Don’t Fall in Love.
